questions.question: Which change is a refactoring?
options: Storing the decision in a variable instead of computing it twice
Sending missing websites to review instead of raising
questions.explanation: Only this change keeps every observable behaviour the same. The others change what the service does.

questions.question: The tests turn red after a refactoring step and the cause is not obvious. What next?
options: Revert to the last green commit and take a smaller step
questions.explanation: A small step that fails is cheap to throw away. Debugging forward mixes the failed step with new edits.

questions.question: Why not refactor and change behaviour in the same commit?
options: It makes the commit message too long.
When tests fail, you cannot tell which change caused it.
questions.explanation: Keeping them apart means a failing test points at one kind of change.
